description: Ground-truth eval set. Each question is labelled with the source doc(s) whose chunks count as a correct retrieval. Questions are deliberately worded differently from the docs to test semantic understanding, not word overlap.

how does the system scale up when traffic increases?
how do we release a new version without downtime?
how can I tell how long a request took and where time went?
what format are the operational metrics exported in?
what stops one caller from overwhelming the service?
how does a caller know it is about to be throttled?
